name: Music
description: Music from Bach and Beethoven to jazz, rock and roll, the Beatles, hip hop and K-pop: the composers, artists and records the world knows.

checkpoints.name: The Baroque
checkpoints.note: Opera is born in Italy. Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel write concertos, oratorios and fugues for church, court and the new public concerts.

checkpoints.name: Classical and Romantic
checkpoints.note: Haydn, Mozart and Beethoven create the symphony and the sonata. Romantic composers from Chopin to Tchaikovsky pour feeling and national colour into music.

checkpoints.name: Jazz and the first records
checkpoints.note: Records and radio carry music to millions. Jazz and the blues grow from African American life, and Stravinsky and Gershwin break the old rules.

checkpoints.name: Rock and roll
checkpoints.note: Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry and Little Richard mix rhythm and blues with country, and teenagers have a music of their own.

checkpoints.name: The Beatles and the album years
checkpoints.note: The Beatles lead the British invasion. Soul, Motown, rock festivals, reggae and disco fill the charts, and in the Bronx DJs invent hip hop.

checkpoints.name: The MTV years
checkpoints.note: Music videos make stars of Michael Jackson and Madonna. Hip hop goes from block parties to the top of the charts, and the CD replaces the record.

checkpoints.name: The streaming era
checkpoints.note: Downloads and then streaming replace the CD. Beyoncé, Taylor Swift and Drake top the world, and K-pop groups such as BTS and BLACKPINK become global stars.
